usage: cox stats bounds [-h] [--db DB] [--json] [--level {strict,moderate,liberal}]
                        [--profile PROFILE] [--write WRITE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --db DB
  --json
  --level {strict,moderate,liberal}
  --profile PROFILE     the routing profile naming the provider profile (default: ~/.config/agent-
                        tools/profile.yaml or $AGENT_TOOLS_PROFILE)
  --write WRITE         also write the JSON table to PATH inside the repo checkout
